title: System Status
webuiInfo: WebUI built with React + Vite + Tailwind CSS

hooks.title: User Hooks
hooks.subtitle: Visual editor for config/hooks.json: run custom scripts before/after tool execution and on reply completion; hot-applied on save
hooks.noHooks: No hooks configured yet — click "Load Example" to get started
hooks.matcherPlaceholder: Tool name glob, e.g. delete_* or *
hooks.commandPlaceholder: Shell command; event JSON arrives on stdin
hooks.hint: Payload is passed via stdin as JSON and mirrored to HOOK_EVENT/HOOK_TOOL env vars; exit 2 = block (stderr as reason); reply_end may rewrite the final reply by printing REPLACE:<json-string> on stdout.
hooks.disabledBanner: Master switch is off: no hook events will fire (configuration is kept; turn it on to resume)
hooks.neverRun: Never run (stats appear here after first trigger)
hooks.testToolPlaceholder: Tool name for matching, e.g. delete_file or *
hooks.testOk: Test finished: {{count}} hooks ran, none blocked
hooks.testNoMatch: No enabled hooks match this tool name
hooks.testDisabledWarning: Master switch is off: the test still runs, but hooks will not fire at runtime
hooks.recentSubtitle: In-memory runtime stats (reset on restart): tells whether hooks actually run, block, or fail

llmHooks.title: LLM Hooks
llmHooks.subtitle: Async LLM work spawned at reply/thinking boundaries (multiple hooks per event run in parallel)
llmHooks.outputNotRouted: Quiet on success; notify AI on failure
llmHooks.hint: AI can inspect get_hooks and edit parameters with update_entity_config. Changes are persisted and apply to future runs; accepted runs keep their original parameters.

localModels.title: Local Model Assets
localModels.runtimeSubtitle: Python runtime for local model inference (onnxruntime); effective immediately after install
localModels.phaseConnecting: Connecting to source… (falls back to mirror if slow)
localModels.proxyHint: Slow or failing? Enable the global proxy in Config

hookJudgment.title: {{provider}} assessment
hookJudgment.slow: Slow response (threshold {{ms}}ms) may offset the time saved by this assessment.
hookJudgment.evaluating: Assessing necessity and evidence category in parallel…
hookJudgment.policy: Skip only when necessity ≤ {{threshold}} and the unnecessary-work basis probability ≥ {{confidence}}; otherwise proceed.
hookJudgment.truncated: Evidence exceeded the assessment budget. No judgment call was made; original work continues to avoid missing facts.

hookFlow.title: Execution flow
hookFlow.syncHint: Waits in order. Only synchronous pre-tool hooks can veto a call with exit 2.
hookFlow.asyncHint: Runs in the background. Results appear in execution history and cannot undo an operation.
hookFlow.retention: The latest 100 executions in this process. Expand for scope, status and results.
hookFlow.empty: Executions will appear here when a hook runs
hookFlow.saveFirst: Save changes before testing the saved scripts.
hookFlow.testHint: Tests execute enabled matching scripts and wait for background hooks.
hookFlow.scriptHint: Use wait for validation, background for audits and notifications. Scripts receive JSON on stdin; up to 4 background workers and 64 pending tasks.
hookFlow.invalid: Enter a command and a timeout between 1 and 60 seconds.

eventsHint.tool_pre: Check arguments and conditions before execution.
eventsHint.tool_post: Process results, audit or trigger follow-up work.
eventsHint.reply_end: Handle completion; does not rewrite or automatically deliver messages.

prepare.title: Prepare context
prepare.body: Initial recall waits for results. Choose depth per task while retaining fixed instructions and provenance.

tools.title: Reason and execute
tools.body: Validation → tool → result hooks. Memory enrichment uses the dynamic tail, preserving cached prefixes.

complete.title: After the reply
complete.body: Skill review and other background work run independently, with status and timing visible here and in the workbench.

hookFlow.expiredDetails: These execution details have left memory or model execution has not started yet. The hook record retains its final status.
hookFlow.callsUntracked: Model and tool calls are not counted for this internal process

recallPolicy.title: Automatic recall
recallPolicy.subtitle: Balance response time and memory depth for each task.
recallPolicy.backgroundHint: For fast / deep modes. Plans enrichment on demand and injects the dynamic tail; stops when the reply ends.
recallPolicy.scope: Sets the global default. AI can use set_recall_policy for this turn; SDK can set recall_policy on an input. Fixed instructions and manual recall remain available.

off.title: Off
off.body: No automatic search. For precise instructions and latency-sensitive tasks.

tags.title: Tags only
tags.body: Exact tag lookup; defaults to participant profiles. No embedding or planning calls.

fast.title: Fast
fast.body: Local hybrid search with bounded embedding latency. Deep analysis runs in the background.

deep.title: Deep
deep.body: Multi-query planning, cross-channel and federated search for complex history and relationships.
